counterfactuals.justification: The requested scalar, not its sign or form, determines the response.

stages_examined: learner history exclusion and difficulty-weighted selection rules
delivery.result: 48 API, 32 paired CLI, and exact 5-record batch all survive filtering. Five original eligible sources plus five candidates form the captured prospective fresh pool. Selection preserves eligibility support when easy has positive weight; histories may remove paired counterparts. No generated stored records exist at basis 5666.

limitations: Finite targeted review cannot prove absence of every shortcut.
Moderate/hard authored routes are unchanged and outside requested easy scope.
Live learner histories, active weights and future entity IDs absent; no guarantee every selected subset remains balanced.
Original absent-only 2x2 source radio remains in captured pool; it is not a generated historical defect.
Source q-13506 has missing answer/solution attributes, independently reconstructed; raw q-13490 is evidence-only for its opaque complete bank.
Missing radio targets conservatively use one index n+1, extending source row absence to column absence; simultaneous missing indices were not required to repair this finding.
